description: This Java interface defines a base response message type for commands related to messages in the Eclipse Ditto project. It specifies methods for retrieving message details, resource paths, and JSON serialization fields, acting as a foundational component for message command responses.

classes.name: MessageCommandResponse
classes.description: A generic interface representing response messages for commands involving messages and features, providing methods for message retrieval, resource path determination, and JSON field definitions.

classes.name: JsonFields
classes.description: Inner class containing static definitions for JSON fields used in serializing and deserializing MessageCommandResponse objects.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the Message object to be delivered as part of this response.

methods.name: getMessageType
methods.description: Provides the message type identifier used for routing purposes, defaulting to getName().

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the associated ThingId; default implementation delegates to getThingEntityId().

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type string associated with message commands.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the DittoHeaders for the message response; returns the instance for chaining.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Computes the JSON Pointer representing the resource's path, based on message direction and subject.
